2a41ab4ff556a5c99e7c5849c60a31a9001e3af5.summary: Traffic-analysis post dated 2024-03-07 describing a Latrodectus malspam infection that leads to Lumma Stealer. Associated files include IOCs, a malspam email, a pcap of the infection traffic, and malware artifacts, all in password-protected zips. The report names no threat actors, sectors, countries or CVEs.
